objective: Retire IGPAT across Android/Web and existing older clients, preserve historical media and all non-IGPAT Community/Marites functionality.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified GitHub main c5d20bfe7cfd8402f21ea2faaa4caa763893a815 (after Marites signed-photo hotfix) was the exact canonical source fast-forwarded to consolidated RC before merging PR #720; live Supabase retirement migration 20261111151816 applied and eight RPCs denied, six historical posts preserved. Android/Web export and production OTA remain unverified until new exact-head CI and production workflows succeed.
chosenApproach: Redirect all IGPAT watch/create/reels/deep links to Community Wall, hide public entry points, deactivate legacy preview mounts without deleting their code, and apply a reversible server-side INSERT/reclassification trigger plus revoke authenticated reel RPC rights. Retain existing IGPAT rows, media paths, interactions and unrelated post/Marites video flows. Release reconciliation: fast-forward existing ancestor-only consolidated candidate to current Main; merge scoped PR #720 into that candidate; compile exact candidate, then promote only after QA.
selectionRationale: Leaving only the button hidden would let old clients continue writing. Dropping tables or deleting old reels risks losing data. Inert client routes plus server enforcement is safely reversible without introducing native modules.
alternativeApproaches: Hide IGPAT shortcut only: rejected; older binaries, deep links, and versioned publish RPCs remain active
Delete all reel rows and functions: rejected; destructive to users and migration dependencies
Dedicated route retirement and non-destructive server-side privilege/trigger block: selected
